title: Boolean algebras: ideals, ultrafilters, and representation
summary: Ultrafilters represent abstract union, intersection, and complement by actual subsets.
abstract: Boolean algebras capture the rules of union, intersection, and complement without requiring their elements to be sets. An ultrafilter makes a consistent choice between each element and its complement. Assuming the axiom of choice, these decisions distinguish distinct elements, so every Boolean algebra can be represented faithfully as a family of subsets closed under the finite set operations. The representing family need not be an entire power set.
